# idnpay-sandbox

> Open-source local payment gateway simulator for Indonesia. It exposes HTTP endpoints that create QRIS, Virtual Account (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, Permata), and e-Wallet (GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, DANA) charges, changes transaction state on demand, and delivers HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks with exponential backoff retries. Runs offline in Docker or with Node.js 22 or newer. It is a development tool, not a payment processor: no money moves and the Virtual Account prefixes are illustrative.

Base URL when running locally: http://localhost:9000

Install: `npx idnpay-sandbox` on Node.js 22 or newer, or `docker compose up -d --build` from the repository.

## Main endpoints

- `POST /v1/charge`: create a transaction. Body: `order_id`, `gross_amount`, `payment_type`, `callback_url`. Header: `X-Client-Key`.
- `POST /v1/simulate/pay`: mark a transaction paid. Body: `transaction_id`.
- `POST /v1/simulate/fail` and `POST /v1/simulate/expire`: the other terminal states.
- `GET /v1/transactions/:transaction_id`: current state.
- `POST /v2/charge`: Midtrans-compatible subset, Basic auth with `SECRET_KEY` as username.

## Webhook signature

`X-IDNPay-Signature` = HMAC-SHA256 of `order_id + status_code + gross_amount` keyed with `SECRET_KEY`, hex encoded. `X-IDNPay-Timestamp` carries the Unix timestamp. Midtrans-compatible webhooks use `signature_key` with SHA512 instead.
